selection_policy: Replace the three disputed old hard items Q14/Q19/Q30 and three straightforward easy items Q11/Q22/Q24, as requested by Keith. Retain all other complete questions and exact AI proposals, with their human decisions. New authored replacements are provisional hard candidates, never relabelled old questions.
duplication_policy: One primary MCQ per family. Reject AST clones after removing formatting, bound identifier names and literal values; preserve operators, built-ins and statement structure. A separate curator review checks reasoning patterns. Neither screen proves semantic uniqueness.

carried_review.notes: Carry-forward is not a new review event. Only unchanged full questions with identical AI proposals retain human decisions; all six replacements need explicit review.
